subject: Publicity window & credit swap request — Prospero pilot
messages: Subject: Pilot pricing + case study ask
Thanks again for the time yesterday — Prospero’s use case (real-time claims triage) maps cleanly to what we built for similar customers. Per our conversation I pulled the pilot economics together:
- Standard rate card would be $0.0035/token; proposal: 30% credit against hosted usage during pilot in exchange for a permissive post-pilot publicity agreement (logo, 1-page case study, 1 quote).

We usually need an OK from my director for credits >25% and any special publicity language that ties to deal concessions. Karthik and Jonas are cc’d to help scope legal and deal-desk approvals. I attached a draft MOU (Prospero_CaseStudy_MOU_draft.pdf) that captures the publicity window and a 9-month embargo option we discussed.
Can you confirm whether Prospero’s legal would be comfortable with the following limited asks:
1) Non-exclusive logo and short quote usage in Redwood marketing materials (web, one case study PDF).
2) Approval on any quote + 3-business-day review window for final materials.
If you’re good with that, I’ll escalate the 30% credit request to Vivek for one-off approval and route the MOU for quick redlines. Hope to lock terms this week so we can start the pilot Aug 3.
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.inference>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.inference>
Subject: [Alert] Approval needed: 30% pilot credit for Prospero in exchange for publicity

Looping you in — Prospero (large regional payer) is asking for a 30% credit on pilot usage in return for a marketing case study and logo. Key constraints: short pilot timeline (3 months), want to start Aug 3. I attached the draft MOU and a marked-up Word with anticipated redlines.
- They requested a 9-month embargo (we proposed either 6 or 9 months).
- They want the ability to review/approve quotes (standard), and they asked for a short video testimonial option — legal flagged that as an additional ask.

Requesting: Vivek, can we approve a one-time 30% hosted-usage credit for the pilot if Marketing agrees to a scoped case study (1 page + logo + quote) and Legal signs off on the 9-month embargo? If so, I’ll prepare a concession memo for the deal desk and route the MOU to Prospero’s legal.
Thanks — fast turnaround appreciated, we’re on a tight toggle with the customer.
Subject: Re: [Alert] Approval needed: 30% pilot credit for Prospero in exchange for publicity
Thanks for the note and context. High-level OK to approve up to 30% credit for a short pilot under the following firm conditions:
1) Marketing commits to producing a 1-page case study + logo placement within 45 days of pilot completion and provides measurable distribution (email + blog + social).
2) No exclusivity and no enterprise testimonial videos without a separate compensation agreement.
3) Legal (Jonas) signs off on the MOU redlines; must include a standard PDP/data handling clause and a mutual PR hold harmless for any patient-case specifics.

If those are satisfied, I authorize a one-off 30% credit. Provide me the concession memo (line-item vs. standard) and confirm margin impact so I can sign off formally. If the customer insists on a 12-month exclusive visibility window or broader IP rights, we decline or counter with a smaller credit.
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.inference>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.inference>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference>
Subject: Re: Prospero MOU — redlines attached
Quick review — I made three clean redlines to keep this within our standard publicity concession profile:
- Limit logo usage to website, case study PDF, and social; no press release without separate sign-off.
- Keep embargo at 9 months acceptable to Marketing; include a 3-business-day approval window on quotes/quotes edits.
- Add mutual indemnity language around customer data/examples (we cannot be liable for clinical claims).

I attached redlines_prospero_mou.docx with tracked changes. If Prospero pushes for a testimonial video, we require an additional marketing credit or remove video from the allowance. Otherwise these are standard. After Marissa sends the concession memo, I’ll finalize legal language for signature.
Cc: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.inference>, Jonas Weber <jonas_weber@redwood.inference>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.inference>
Subject: Revised MOU & confirmation of pilot credit — Prospero
Thanks for the quick sync earlier. Per our conversation and internal approvals:
- Redwood will provide a one-time 30% credit on hosted usage during the 3-month pilot (Deal ID: DEAL-PROS-2026-07).

- In exchange, Prospero grants Redwood non-exclusive logo usage, a 1-page written case study and a short quote. No video testimonial is included in this concession unless separately agreed and credited.
- Embargo: marketing materials may not be published until 9 months after pilot start (we discussed Aug 3 start => embargo lifts May 3, 2027).

I’ve attached the revised MOU with our redlines and Jonas’ legal notes. Please have your legal team review and return any edits by next Wednesday 8/4 so we can finalize signatures and meet the Aug 3 start. Once Prospero signs, Karthik will post the concession memo to the deal record and I will confirm the credit schedule with finance.
